title: Black Canyon Ultras 2026 results: Record-breaking wins for Lichter and Troyer — RUN247
claims: The 2026 Black Canyon 100K started at 07:00 from Mayer High School, with 62 miles ahead and 55 of them on the Black Canyon National Recreation Trail.
Hans Troyer won the men's 100K in 7:20:00, with Anthony Costales second in 7:24:32 and Tracen Knopp third in 7:26:45; Canyon Woodward was fourth and Jordan Bramblett fifth.
Troyer and Woodward already had Western States places, so the three men's Golden Tickets went to Troyer, Costales and Knopp.
Jennifer Lichter won the women's 100K in 7:57:05, with Anne Flower second in 7:58:15 and Tara Dower third in 8:11:46; Molly Seidel was fourth in 8:25:13 and Abby Hall fifth in 8:27:50.
Because Dower already had a Western States place, the third women's Golden Ticket rolled down to fourth-placed Seidel, so Lichter, Flower and Seidel took the three women's tickets.
RUN247 calls both Troyer's and Lichter's runs course records and reports that six Golden Tickets were handed out.
